senses.gloss: pr. n. (v. נֵס) Mount Nissay (Miracle), a substitute for Sinai, introduced for argument.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 89a:7">Sabb. 89ᵃ</cite> (against one explaining <he>הר סֹינֹי</he> as <he>הר שנעשו בו נ̇יס̇ים</he>, the mount whereon miracles were wrought for Israel) <he>הר נ׳ מיבעי ליה</he> then its name ought to have been Har Nissay; v. <cite ref="O00713"><he>סִימָנַאי</he></cite>.
